name: Dirty Shot
body:
You love to fight dirty from a long range. When an opponent’s back is turned to you, you know how to hit them just right to cause them large amounts of pain.

Prerequisite(s): 2nd-level Arcane Archer

Benefit: Whenever you attack an opponent that has their back turned to you with an arrow and hit, your arrow does twice the normal amount of damage. This includes all types of damage except spell damage.
